probe_source:
import sys,json,time,subprocess,socket
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/lhl/hipEngine')
from scripts.qwen4exp_mtp_inprocess_bench import build_chat_prompt
from scripts.qwen4exp_mtp_phase_census import DEFAULT_MODEL,DEFAULT_SIDECAR
from hipengine.execution_profiles import ExecutionProfile,resolve_runtime_profile
from hipengine.generation.qwen4_exp_gguf import Qwen4ExpGGUFTextGenerator
from hipengine.generation.qwen4_exp_mtp import Qwen4ExpMTPTextProvider
from hipengine.generation.qwen4_exp_profiles import QWEN4_EXP_BACKEND,QWEN4_EXP_MODEL,QWEN4_EXP_QUANTS,register_qwen4_exp_gfx1151_profiles
from hipengine.generation.registry import GenerationRequest
from hipengine.kernels.hip_gfx1151 import register_gfx1151_kernels
from hipengine.loading.gguf import discover_gguf_files,load_gguf_index
from hipengine.models import resolve_model
from hipengine.speculative.registry import SpeculativeProviderConfig
register_gfx1151_kernels(replace=True);register_qwen4_exp_gfx1151_profiles()
index=load_gguf_index(discover_gguf_files(DEFAULT_MODEL)[0])
profile=resolve_runtime_profile(model=QWEN4_EXP_MODEL,backend=QWEN4_EXP_BACKEND,quant=QWEN4_EXP_QUANTS[1],profile=ExecutionProfile('production'))
generator=profile.construct_generator(lambda:Qwen4ExpGGUFTextGenerator(model_path=DEFAULT_MODEL,weight_index=index,model_plugin=resolve_model(index.architecture or ''),backend=QWEN4_EXP_BACKEND,max_sequence_length=1024,prefill_chunk_size=1024))
provider=Qwen4ExpMTPTextProvider(target_generator=generator,config=SpeculativeProviderConfig(provider='qwen4_exp_mtp',draft_model=DEFAULT_SIDECAR,candidate_budget=3))
generator.attach_speculative_provider(provider)
report=dict(kind='direct_provider_stream_functional_only',source_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),host=socket.gethostname(),rows=[])
path=Path('/tmp/he-direct-stream-report.json')
try:
 for text in ('Explain what a Python generator does in two sentences.','日本語で、虹ができる理由を説明してください。'):
  prompt=tuple(map(int,build_chat_prompt(generator.tokenizer,text)))
  for logs in (False,True):
   request=GenerationRequest(prompts=(prompt,),max_tokens=32,temperature=0.,top_p=1.,top_k=1,ignore_eos=True,logprobs=logs,top_logprobs=5 if logs else 0)
   start=time.monotonic();stream=provider.stream_detailed(request);first=next(stream);first_s=time.monotonic()-start
   assert first.finish_details is None and 0<len(first.generated_token_ids)<32
   chunks=[first,*stream];wall=time.monotonic()-start
   reference=provider.generate_detailed(request)[0]
   assert chunks[-1].generated_token_ids==reference.generated_token_ids
   assert ''.join(c.text for c in chunks)==reference.text
   assert tuple(p for c in chunks for p in c.token_logprobs)==reference.token_logprobs
   assert sum(c.finish_details is not None for c in chunks)==1
   assert chunks[-1].finish_details==reference.finish_details
   interrupted=provider.stream_detailed(request);next(interrupted);interrupted.close()
   recovered=list(provider.stream_detailed(request))
   assert recovered[-1].generated_token_ids==reference.generated_token_ids
   assert ''.join(c.text for c in recovered)==reference.text
   assert tuple(p for c in recovered for p in c.token_logprobs)==reference.token_logprobs
   row=dict(prompt=text,logprobs=logs,chunks=len(chunks),first_tokens=len(first.generated_token_ids),total_tokens=len(reference.generated_token_ids),first_seconds_diagnostic=first_s,wall_seconds_diagnostic=wall,stream_blocking_agreement=True,early_close_recovery=True)
   report['rows'].append(row);path.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(row,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 report['passed']=True
finally:
 generator.close();path.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
limitations: Functional direct-provider C1 greedy streaming only; not a throughput, numerical-envelope, or task-quality gate.
Four cases: two prompts, logprobs off/on, 32 generated tokens, candidate budget 3.
